title: Circulating MicroRNA Quantification Using DNA-binding Dye Chemistry and Droplet Digital PCR
protocol: Thaw serum/plasma samples on ice.
Add 1 ml of Lysis Reagent to 200 µl serum/plasma.
Mix by vortexing and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 3 µl of a 4.16 nM solution of cel-miR-39-3p synthetic miRNA from C. elegans.
Add 200 µl of chloroform.
Shake the tube vigorously for 15 sec.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g and 4 °C for 15 min to separate phases.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, avoiding interphase material.
Add 1 ml of 100% ethanol and mix by inversion.
Pipette up 700 µl of the sample into a mini spin column placed on a 2 ml collection tube.
Close the lid and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 sec.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat the last two steps using the remaining sample.
Add 700 µl Buffer RWT to the mini spin column.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 15 sec at 12,000 x g to wash the column.
Discard the flow-through.
Pipette 500 µl Buffer RPE into the mini spin column.
Close the lid and centrifuge for 15 sec at 12,000 rpm.
Discard the flow-through.
Repeat this step again.
Centrifuge the mini spin column at full speed for 2 min to dry the spin column membrane from residual ethanol.
Transfer the mini spin column to a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Pipette 35 µl RNase-free water on the membrane of the column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 12,000 x g to elute the RNA.
Store the RNA at -80 °C.
Thaw the reverse transcription (RT) reagent mix components: 5x reaction buffer and nuclease-free water.
Mix gently inverting the tubes and place on ice.
Immediately before use, remove the enzyme mix from the freezer and place on ice.
Spin down all reagents.
Prepare the RT reagent mix on ice as described in Table 1.
Prepare at least 10% exceeding mix.
Mix the reaction by pipetting, and then spin down.
Incubate for 60 min at 42 ˚C.
Heat-inactivate the reverse transcriptase for 5 min at 95 ˚C.
Immediately cool to 4 °C.
Store the cDNA at -20 °C.
Dilute the cDNA template in nuclease-free water based on target miRNA abundance, between a ratio of 1:50 and 1:500.
Store diluted cDNA at -20°C for long-term stability.
Thaw and equilibrate master mix (e.g., EvaGreen Master Mix), microRNA primer set, and cDNA at room temperature.
Mix the master mix thoroughly by inverting the tube several times.
Spin down all reagents.
Prepare ddPCR mix as described in Table 2.
Create a ddPCR mix working solution if multiple reactions are performed.
Ensure to prepare at least 10% excess mix for each preparation.
Thoroughly mix and spin down the prepared ddPCR mix.
Dispense 12 µl of ddPCR mix into a 96-well PCR plate or PCR tubes.
Add 8 µl of diluted cDNA template to each tube/well.
Insert droplet generator cartridge into holder.
Transfer 20 µl of each sample carefully to the sample wells (middle row) of the droplet generator cartridge while avoiding air bubbles at the bottom.
Fill oil wells (bottom row) with 70 µl of droplet generator oil.
Hook the gasket over the cartridge holder.
Insert into the droplet generator.
Close the lid to start droplet generation according to manufacturer's protocol.
Open the lid when droplet generation has finished.
Remove the disposable gasket from the device.
Pipet slowly and smoothly 40 µl of the contents of each of the eight top wells (the droplets) into a single column of a 96-well PCR plate.
Seal the PCR plate with pierceable foil immediately after transferring droplets to avoid evaporation.
Begin thermal cycling within 30 min of sealing the plate according to Table 3.
Power on the droplet reader.
Move the plate from the thermal cycler to the droplet reader.
Place the 96-well PCR plate containing the post-PCR droplets into the base of the plate holder.
Place the top of the plate holder on the PCR plate.
Firmly press both release tabs down to secure the PCR plate in the holder.
Start the software from the system PC.
Click Setup to define the experiment (Absolute quantification).
Click Run to start the droplet reading.
When droplet reading is complete, click "Analyze" button to open and analyze the data.
Use the Events tab to check the number of positive and total droplets.
Expect a total number of 18,000 - 21,000 droplets with probeless ddPCR.
Select positive droplets once identified.
Export miRNA concentration values using the export .csv option from the Concentration tab.
